name: mlbb-co-pilot
description: Semantic tactical intelligence system for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.
author: SpectralAV

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "node electron/wait-and-start.cjs"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,PROXY -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run local-proxy"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.cv:status: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = 'data/cv/.venv/Scripts/python.exe'; if (Test-Path $p) { & $p backend/tools/ultralyticsVision.py status --project-root . } else { python backend/tools/ultralyticsVision.py status --project-root . }"
scripts.cv:roboflow:inference:install: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = 'data/cv/.venv-roboflow/Scripts/python.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $p)) { python -m venv data/cv/.venv-roboflow }; & $p -m pip install -r backend/cv/roboflow-inference-requirements.txt"
scripts.cv:roboflow:inference:status: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = 'data/cv/.venv-roboflow/Scripts/python.exe'; if (Test-Path $p) { & $p backend/tools/roboflowInference.py status --project-root . } else { data/cv/.venv/Scripts/python.exe backend/tools/roboflowInference.py status --project-root . }"
scripts.cv:roboflow:inference:docker: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = 'data/cv/.venv-roboflow/Scripts/python.exe'; if (Test-Path $p) { & $p backend/tools/roboflowInference.py status --project-root . --check-docker } else { data/cv/.venv/Scripts/python.exe backend/tools/roboflowInference.py status --project-root . --check-docker }"
scripts.cv:result:status: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = 'data/cv/.venv/Scripts/python.exe'; if (Test-Path $p) { & $p backend/tools/resultScreenVision.py status --project-root . } else { python backend/tools/resultScreenVision.py status --project-root . }"
scripts.cv:draft:roboflow:enhance: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowTrainingData.py import --project-root . --dataset-name roboflow-draft-recognition --profile draft-slots --roboflow-workspace mobile-legends-draft-pick --roboflow-project mobile-legends-draft-recognition --roboflow-version latest --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/mobile-legends-draft-pick/mobile-legends-draft-recognition
scripts.cv:minimap:roboflow:import: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowDraftDataset.py --project-root . --target-name roboflow-minimap-2 --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/aung-khant-kyaw/mlbbminimap-2 --scope "Mobile Legends minimap hero-icon recognition"
scripts.cv:minimap:roboflow:enhance: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowTrainingData.py import --project-root . --dataset-name roboflow-minimap-2 --profile minimap-markers --default-minimap-side enemy --roboflow-workspace aung-khant-kyaw --roboflow-project mlbbminimap-2 --roboflow-version latest --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/aung-khant-kyaw/mlbbminimap-2
scripts.cv:minimap:roboflow:enhance:gladi: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowTrainingData.py import --project-root . --dataset-name roboflow-gladi-minimap --profile minimap-markers --default-minimap-side enemy --roboflow-workspace gladi --roboflow-project mobile-legends-minimap-dataset --roboflow-version latest --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/gladi/mobile-legends-minimap-dataset
scripts.cv:hud:roboflow:enhance:ocr: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowTrainingData.py import --project-root . --dataset-name roboflow-gladi-ocr --profile hud-ocr --roboflow-workspace gladi --roboflow-project mobile-legends-ocr --roboflow-version latest --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/gladi/mobile-legends-ocr
scripts.cv:camera:roboflow:enhance:objectives: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowTrainingData.py import --project-root . --dataset-name roboflow-camera-objectives --profile camera-objectives --roboflow-workspace video-annotation-hvs0h --roboflow-project mobile-legends-project --roboflow-version latest --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/video-annotation-hvs0h/mobile-legends-project
scripts.cv:items:roboflow:enhance: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/importRoboflowTrainingData.py import --project-root . --dataset-name roboflow-post-match-items --profile post-match-items --roboflow-workspace duks-workspace --roboflow-project mobile-legends-items --roboflow-version latest --universe-url https://universe.roboflow.com/duks-workspace/mobile-legends-items
scripts.cv:minimap:roboflow:status: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/roboflowDraftVision.py status --project-root . --target-name roboflow-minimap-2 --weight-name mlbb-roboflow-minimap.pt --engine-name ultralytics-roboflow-minimap
scripts.cv:minimap:roboflow:train: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/roboflowDraftVision.py train --project-root . --target-name roboflow-minimap-2 --weight-name mlbb-roboflow-minimap.pt --run-name mlbb-roboflow-minimap --engine-name ultralytics-roboflow-minimap --device auto --batch 4 --workers 0 --amp false
scripts.cv:minimap:roboflow:infer: data\cv\.venv\Scripts\python.exe backend/tools/roboflowDraftVision.py infer --project-root . --target-name roboflow-minimap-2 --weight-name mlbb-roboflow-minimap.pt --engine-name ultralytics-roboflow-minimap --source-label roboflow-minimap-yolo
